home.heroText: A refuge among the mountains where time moves at your own pace — lush gardens, cozy rooms, and skies that look different from up here.
home.heroImageAlt: View of the Sacred Valley mountains from a room at Apu Garden Lodge

servicios.gardenText: Trails through native flora, shaded corners and stone benches — the garden at Apu Garden Lodge is as much a part of your stay as the room itself.

novedad.title: See the sky like never before
novedad.subtitle: Apu Garden Lodge added an astronomical telescope so our guests can observe the sky of the Sacred Valley — one of the clearest and darkest in the country — with a level of detail you won't forget.
novedad.cta: Book your night under the stars
novedad.heroImageAlt: Observatory under the Milky Way, starry sky
novedad.experienceTitle: A sky that feels within reach
novedad.experienceText1: Free of light pollution and high up in the valley, the sky over Apu Garden Lodge opens up differently. Our team guides you every night to find planets, star clusters and the Milky Way through the lodge's telescope — an experience included for everyone staying with us.
novedad.experienceText2: Available every clear night. Just bundle up — we'll take care of the rest.
novedad.secondaryImageAlt: Starry sky with the Milky Way over a mountain silhouette
novedad.quote: “I had never seen so many stars at once.”
novedad.quoteAuthor: — A guest at Apu Garden Lodge

nosotros.title: The story behind the lodge
nosotros.originText1: Apu Garden Lodge was born from a simple idea: build a place where the nature of the Sacred Valley would be the protagonist, not just the backdrop. “Apu” — mountain spirit in Quechua — guides every corner of the lodge, from the gardens to the nights we spend looking at the sky.
nosotros.originText2: Today we keep growing with that same idea: less noise, more nature, and experiences that truly stay with you.

reservas.faqSubtitle: What guests ask most before booking.

faq.q: What room types does Apu Garden Lodge have?
faq.a: Five: Single, Double, Double Deluxe, Double Deluxe with two beds, and Deluxe with an extra-large bed. All have a private bathroom and garden views.

faq.q: How far is it from downtown Urubamba?

faq.a: Yes, we welcome families and children of any age. We don't have cribs or extra beds.

faq.q: What are the check-in and check-out times?
faq.a: Check-in is from 11:00 am onward and check-out is by 10:00 am. We're flexible — if you need more time, just coordinate it with us based on your itinerary.

faq.q: How much does it cost to stay?
faq.a: Price varies by room type, starting at S/77 per night. Check the availability search for the exact price on your dates.
Free cancellation up to 24 hours before check-in. After that, the full stay is charged.
Yes, on request and at no extra cost.

terminos.title: Terms and Conditions
terminos.subtitle: In effect since October 2026 — please read before sending a booking request.

sections.heading: Acceptance of terms
body: By using this website and submitting a booking request at Apu Garden Lodge, you accept these Terms and Conditions. If you do not agree with them, please do not use the site or submit booking requests.

sections.heading: Bookings and availability
body: Requests submitted through this site are not automatically a confirmed booking: they are subject to confirmation by our team via email or WhatsApp, based on the actual availability of the requested room type.
If the chosen room type has no availability for the requested dates, the request is placed on a waitlist and we'll reach out as soon as a room becomes available.

sections.heading: Rates and payment
body: Rates are shown in Peruvian soles (S/) and US dollars (US$) per night, depending on the room type. Payment is made directly at the hotel — this site does not process online payments or store card details.

sections.heading: Check-in and check-out
body: Check-in is from 10:00 to 12:00. Check-out has no fixed time — it's coordinated with our team based on your departure itinerary.

sections.heading: Cancellations
body: You can cancel your booking free of charge up to 24 hours before check-in. After that window, or in case of a no-show, the full stay is charged.

sections.heading: Use of the site
body: The content on this site (text, photographs, design) belongs to Apu Garden Lodge or is used with the corresponding authorization. It may not be reproduced for commercial purposes without prior written authorization.

sections.heading: Liability
body: Apu Garden Lodge is not liable for indirect damages arising from the use of this website, for service interruptions caused by circumstances beyond our control, or for errors in the information shown that are corrected promptly once identified.

sections.heading: Governing law
body: These terms are governed by the laws of the Republic of Peru. Any dispute arising from their interpretation or enforcement is subject to the courts of Cusco, Peru.

sections.heading: Contact
body: For questions about these terms, message us on WhatsApp at +51 937 454 282 or through the channels listed on the Contact page.

privacidad.title: Privacy Policy
privacidad.subtitle: How we collect, use and protect your personal data when you request a reservation.

sections.heading: Data controller
body: Apu Garden Lodge, located at Cidruchayoc, lote 178, sector Yanaconas, Urubamba, Cusco, Peru, is responsible for processing the personal data you share with us through this site.

sections.heading: What data we collect
body: When you submit a booking request we collect: full name, email address, phone number (optional), arrival and departure dates, number of guests, requested room type, and any notes you add.
If you message us on WhatsApp, that platform's own privacy terms also apply.

sections.heading: How we use your data
body: We use this information solely to manage your booking request, confirm availability, contact you by email or WhatsApp, and coordinate your stay.

sections.heading: Who we share your data with
body: We do not sell or share your data with third parties for advertising purposes. Your information is recorded in the hotel's internal management system, for the exclusive use of Apu Garden Lodge staff.

sections.heading: Cookies and analytics
body: This site does not use tracking cookies or third-party analytics tools.

sections.heading: How long we keep your data
body: We retain your booking data for as long as your relationship with the hotel lasts, plus any additional time needed for administrative or legal purposes.

sections.heading: Your rights
body: Under Peru's Law No. 29733 (Personal Data Protection Law), you may request access, rectification, cancellation, or objection (ARCO rights) regarding your personal data by writing to us through the contact channels listed below.

sections.heading: Security
body: We take reasonable measures to protect your information, although no system is completely infallible.

sections.heading: Changes to this policy
body: We may update this policy from time to time. The last-updated date is shown at the top of this page.

sections.heading: Contact
body: To exercise your rights or ask questions about this policy, message us on WhatsApp at +51 937 454 282 or through the form on the Contact page.

libro.title: Claims and complaints
libro.subtitle: Under Peru's consumer protection regulation, you can file a claim or complaint here about the service at Apu Garden Lodge.
libro.note: A claim expresses disagreement with the lodging service itself. A complaint expresses dissatisfaction with how you were attended to. In both cases, we'll respond within 30 calendar days at most.
